1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel for the State.
2. The petitioner has applied for license for operating a meat shop.
In this process a report has been sought, as claimed by the petitioner, from the Superintendent of Police, Bahraich by the Food Safety Arif vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko ...

3. If any such report has been sought by the aforesaid department let the opposite party no. 2 get the facts verified and do the needful as per law but with expedition, say, within a period of three weeks unless there is any legal impediment in which case he shall inform the petitioner and the department concerned in writing.

4. With the aforesaid observations/directions, the writ petition is disposed of.
.
